# Ritik Soni — Content Creator, Commercial Film Director & Lead Video Editor

> Ritik Soni is an Indian Content Creator, Commercial Film Director, and Lead Video Editor based in Pune and Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He specializes in high-retention short-form video creation (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts), commercial brand films, creator-led digital series, and behavioral audience hook psychology. He has generated over 50M+ cumulative organic impressions across client campaigns and personal creator channels.

## Core Disciplines & Services
1. **Digital Content Creation**: Conceptualizing, scripting, filming, and producing vertical video series (9:16) with 3-second scroll-stopping hooks and high watch-time retention.
2. **Commercial Film Directing**: Directing multi-camera corporate commercials, executive summit recap films, and lifestyle brand documentaries.
3. **Post-Production & Editing**: Frame-accurate NLE cutting in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve Studio with micro-pacing and kinetic typography.
4. **Cinematic Color Grading**: Broadcast Rec.709 and ACES color grading with custom film print emulation (Kodak 2383).
5. **Sound Design & Transients**: Multi-layered Foley, whooshes, risers, and broadcast-calibrated LUFS loudness mixing.
6. **Social Media Growth Strategy**: Full-funnel content calendars, algorithmic trend scouting, and organic distribution engineering.
